died.name: John Bradford
died.cause: to John Leaf, a fellow martyr, prior to being burned at the stake
died.last_words: Be of good comfort, brother, for we shall have a merry supper with the Lord this night: if there be any way to heaven on horseback or in fiery chariots, this is it.

died.name: François-Jean de la Barre
died.cause: prior to execution by beheading for blasphemy and sacrilege
died.last_words: I did not think that they would put a young gentleman to death for such a trifle.

died.name: John F. Reynolds
died.desc: Union general of the American Civil War
died.cause: prior to being fatally shot at the Battle of Gettysburg
died.last_words: Forward men forward for God's sake and drive those fellows out of those woods.

died.name: Josiah Quincy III
died.desc: Mayor of Boston and President of Harvard University
died.cause: hearing his daughter read to him about Lieutenant Colonel Joseph Bailey saving the Union fleet during the Red River Campaign
died.last_words: That is true glory. I will hear no more.

died.name: Leandro N. Alem
died.cause: his suicide note, quoting the motto of the Radical Civic Union
died.last_words: Yes, that is broken, but does not bend!

died.name: Captain Buckey O'Neill
died.desc: captain in Theodore Roosevelt's Rough Riders
died.cause: one of Theodore Roosevelt's Rough Riders, just before being shot in the mouth prior to charge up Kettle Hill
died.last_words: Sergeant, the Spanish bullet isn't made that will kill me.

died.name: Charles L. Kelly
died.desc: United States Army helicopter pilot and medical evacuation unit commander
died.cause: responding to warning to leave a dangerous landing zone during a Vietnam War rescue mission. Kelly was then struck by a bullet

died.name: Michael Landon
died.cause: when one of his sons said it was time to move on
died.last_words: You're right. It's time. I love you all.

born.name: Frederick II of Denmark
born.last_words: Let the pulse beat as it may, we know the mercy of God will never fail.

born.name: George Sand
born.last_words: Farewell, I am going to die. Goodbye Lina, goodbye Maurice, goodbye Lolo, good ...

born.name: Diana
born.desc: former princess consort of Charles, Prince of Wales
born.cause: shortly after being fatally injured in a car accident
